In the young and strong, it will certainly become a chronic disease; in the old and weak, it will mostly lead to death. <ins>Modified Spleen-Returning Decoction (加味歸脾湯)</ins>
Charred gardenia (黑梔, one qian), moutan bark (牡丹皮, one qian), ginseng (人參, one qian), astragalus (黃耆, honey-fried, one and a half qian), atractylodes (白朮, stir-fried, one and a half qian), poria with hostwood (茯神, two qian), jujube seed (棗仁, stir-fried, one and a half qian), dang gui (當歸, one qian), saussurea (木香, five fen), polygala (遠志, core removed, eight fen), longan flesh (圓肉, two qian), licorice (甘草, honey-fried, five fen)
With the guiding herbs ginger (薑) and jujube (棗), decoct in water and take. <ins>Two Aged Decoction (二陳湯)</ins>
Tangerine peel (陳皮, one and a half qian), pinellia (半夏, processed, two qian), poria (茯苓, two qian), licorice (甘草, five fen)
With the guiding herb ginger, decoct in water and take.
